source:
🧸 Squishy Tower: 250+ Stages
Theme: Everything is made from soft, squishy toys and foods. Each world has a different squishy style with unique obstacles.🟨 World 1 - Butter Land (Stages 1-50)
Butter stick jumps
Melting butter slides
Butter cube maze
Toast platforms
Pancake stack climb
Butter waterfall
🟢 World 2 - NeeDoh World (Stages 51-100)
Giant NeeDoh balls
Stretchy bridges
Squish launch pads
Bubble tunnels
Color-changing platforms
Bounce rooms
🥟 World 3 - Dumpling Village (Stages 101-150)
Steamed dumplings
Chopstick balance beams
Soy sauce lakes
Bamboo steamers
Giant bao jumps
Noodle swings
🍡 World 4 - Mochi & Candy (Stages 151-200)
Mochi trampolines
Jelly cubes
Marshmallow clouds
Gummy bear parkour
Lollipop spinning poles
Cotton candy climb
🌈 World 5 - Ultimate Squishy Factory (Stages 201-250+)
Squishy-making machines
Conveyor belts
Giant presses (safe timing obstacles)
Rainbow slime rivers
Squishy monster boss escape
Neon rainbow finale
⭐ Bonus Stages (251-300)
Impossible Butter Challenge
Invisible Squishies
Tiny Mode
Giant Mode
Speed Run
Low Gravity
Rainbow Tower
Lava Squish
Ice Squish
Secret Developer Room
🎁 Collectibles
🧈 Butter Pets
🟢 NeeDoh Pets
🥟 Dumpling Pets
🍡 Mochi Pets
🧸 Teddy Squishy
🐸 Frog Squishy
🦄 Unicorn Squishy
🐼 Panda Squishy
🏆 Rewards
Checkpoint every 5 stages
Free trails
Squishy-themed badges
Daily spin wheel
Secret hidden rooms
Rebirth system
VIP area with exclusive squishies
This gives you 300 stages total, with plenty of variety so the tower doesn't feel repetitive. You can also add seasonal updates (Halloween, Christmas, Easter, Summer) with new squishy-themed stages and collectibles to keep players coming back.

image_prompt.text: A chain of squishy platforms wrapping upward through the tower - butter sticks, dumplings, mochi, jelly cubes - spaced to jump limits
Giant squishy presses and vanishing platforms timed so the player has to move through on the beat
Pancake stack climbs, cotton candy climbs and chopstick balance beams
Butter stick jumps, mochi trampolines, squish launch pads and giant bao jumps
Factory conveyor belts, spinning lollipop poles, swinging noodle ropes and stretchy bridges
A butter cube maze section partway through world one
Soy sauce lakes, rainbow slime rivers and the lava squish section as contact-lethal surfaces
A neon rainbow finale at the top of the tower with trails and badges handed out
Squishy landing pads every five stages
Five stacked themed worlds - Butter Land, NeeDoh World, Dumpling Village, Mochi and Candy, Ultimate Squishy Factory - each visually distinct
Secret hidden rooms tucked off the main route, including a developer room
A VIP area holding exclusive squishies
A butter waterfall, bubble tunnels, marshmallow clouds and bamboo steamers as world set dressing
A squishy monster boss escape section in the factory world

layout_placement.text: Respawn points every five stages so a fall does not restart the tower
The rainbow finale reward area at the summit
Squishy pets placed on risky lines through every world - butter, NeeDoh, dumpling, mochi, teddy, frog, unicorn and panda

notes: 300 stages cannot be framed in one top-down image. The buildable decomposition is one pass per world - five worlds of fifty stages plus a bonus block of fifty - rather than a single tower render.
Bonus stages that change player physics rather than geometry (Tiny Mode, Giant Mode, Low Gravity, Invisible Squishies) are mechanics layered on existing stages, not separate layout.
No option covers a secret room or a VIP area, so both are carried as free text.

open_questions.ask: 300 stages will not fit one image. Do you want the five worlds built as five separate towers stacked in fiction, or one continuous spiral generated in passes?
Is each world its own tower with a teleporter between them, or does one tower run all the way up?

theme: Squishy toys and foods - soft rounded pastel shapes, oversaturated and playful

coverage_missing.ask: How should 300 stages be decomposed for image generation?
One continuous tower, or five towers linked by teleporters?
Is this a Tower of Hell style timed reset, or a persistent climb you keep progress in?

answers.ask: 300 stages will not fit one image. Do you want the five worlds built as five separate towers stacked in fiction, or one continuous spiral generated in passes?
answers.answer: Build the five worlds as five separate themed towers, progressing in order from Butter Land through the Ultimate Squishy Factory; this keeps each world distinct and manageable.

answers.ask: Is each world its own tower with a teleporter between them, or does one tower run all the way up?
answers.answer: Each world is its own tower, with a teleporter at the completed tower’s top leading to the next world.
